meaning.en: the sage Krishnadvaipayana, seeing him set out
meaning.hi: प्रव्रजन को देखकर कृष्णद्वैपायन मुनि

meaning.en: then all beings, stationary and mobile, watched him

meaning.en: hearing this fully, Vyasa, son of Satyavati

meaning.en: together with his son, in love, attained supreme bliss
meaning.hi: पुत्र सहित प्रेमपूर्वक परमानंद प्राप्त किया

meaning.hi: जो गुरु-अनुग्रह से रहस्योपनिषद् पढ़ता है

meaning.en: freed of all wrongdoing, directly attains liberation
